title: Reproducibility Report for SC25 Paper Story of Two GPUs: Characterizing the Resilience of Hopper H100 and Ampere A100 GPUs
problem: Reproducibility of GPU resilience characterization studies requires independent artifact evaluation.
motivation: SC25 Reproducibility Initiative aims to validate published results through independent evaluation.
method: The authors tested whether the results from a published study on GPU reliability could be independently verified. They obtained H100 Hopper and A100 Ampere GPUs and recreated the experiments exactly as described in the original paper 'Story of Two GPUs' by Cui et al., documenting their experimental setup and comparing results. This independent verification—called artifact evaluation—confirms whether published conclusions about GPU resilience are trustworthy when others follow the same steps.
key_novelty: Independent verification of GPU resilience findings for H100 and A100 GPUs by reproducing the original experiments.
contributions: Artifact evaluation of GPU resilience characterization
Documentation of SC25 Reproducibility Initiative work
limitations: Reproducibility report only; limited details without access to full original paper content
